hook: The Transformer relies entirely on self-attention, eschewing recurrence.

takeaways.text: It allows significantly more parallelization than recurrent models by avoiding sequential processing.
Multi-head attention enables the model to attend to different representation subspaces simultaneously.
It achieves state-of-the-art BLEU scores at less than one-quarter the training cost of previous models.

question: How has the shift from recurrence to attention impacted your workflow?
